objective: Ensure V31 production AAB prebuild gate avoids obsolete staging version 1.3.4 assertions and directly runs V31 release identity regression.
productionBaselineEvidence: Latest V31 workflow from merge ebefe2db runs V29/V30 tests with staging identity version 1.3.4, but latest main staging version is 1.3.6; those tests are stale and would falsely fail before the paid EAS build.
chosenApproach: Use current-source native compatibility and staging icon tests plus the dedicated V31 production release test in the V31 workflow. Leave archived V29/V30 source tests and current app code unchanged.
selectionRationale: A narrow build-workflow test selection correction preserves feature tests and release verification while eliminating an obsolete staging metadata assertion unrelated to production V31.
alternativeApproaches: Downgrade staging app version: rejected due existing signed staging app source and upgrade regression.
Rewrite historical V29 and V30 tests globally: rejected as retrospective evidence corruption and unnecessary release scope.
preserveBehaviors: Production version 1.3.6/code31 runtime1.3.2 green B icon runner overlay remains unchanged
No OTA, web, Play or DB action
Current source main feature and regression tests stay intact
acceptanceChecks: Workflow executes focused native + staging + V31 identity tests before EAS build
